==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am at a comic shop. It is one I haven't been to in a long time. It is more like an arcade than I remember.

I see a lot of people that I haven't seen since college. It feels like a reunion. I am not sure why everyone seems to be here.

One of my friends tells a funny joke. I laugh and my other friends give me confused glances. My friend who told the joke is dead, and I am the only one who seems to see his ghost.
